title: Southern Living Rental | Designer WaterColor Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Stay at Southern Living Cottage, a designer WaterColor retreat with a private pool, LSV, bikes, and pet friendly
description_expanded: Southern Living Cottage Features - Complimentary access to a 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart)- some restrictions apply and must sign waiver to use cart during your stay - Enjoy 7 bikes during your stay. Perfect for exploring WaterColor and 30A - 2 Min Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor - 6 Min Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club - Private Dip Pool - can be heated for an additional fee October through April - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Pets not allowed in the private pool. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway - Indoor gas fireplace - Outdoor wood burning fireplace - 8 Beach Chairs and 3 Umbrellas - 1st Floor King Suite - Screened-in front porch with outdoor dining, cushioned seating - Screened-in back porch overlooked pine trees and walking path for a more private feeling - Full gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, Sub Zero and Wolf appliances - Living room wet bar with ice maker and wine fridge - Dining area with seating for 7 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - 1st Floor Powder Room - TVs throughout home with cable - WIFI with routers on 1st and 2nd floor for whole home coverage - Laundry room with washer and dryer plus storage area - Outdoor shower - Access to Camp WaterColor and WaterColor Beach Club included with your reservation - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, beach service, baby equipment rentals, private chef, and catered beach bonfires. Southern Living Cottage is a chic and cozy vacation home away from home. Expansive windows mean lots of natural light throughout the home. Both indoor and outdoor fireplaces plus screened in porches with cushioned seating create inviting spaces to enjoy all year round. Only 0.5 miles to the new Camp WaterColor. Lots of extras available, making this a delightful home to enjoy all WaterColor and 30A has to offer. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, private entrance to screened in porch, ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | Dresser and closet storage, TV, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
2nd Floor King Suite 3 | Dresser and closet storage, TV, ensuite bath with walk in shower
Bonus | Two Twin Beds in private 2nd floor alcove, under-bed storage, TV

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
